title: Dining Room
note: Dining Room pack (tools/make_dining_assets.py). The size (dimensions_m) comes from the universal _base_dimensions schema.

style.label: Style
style.note: Classic (turned legs, rolled arms, mouldings, brass) or modern (clean lines, slim tapered legs, black metal).

color.label: Colour
color.note: The colour of the bedding and upholstery or of the wood: burgundy, forest, navy, camel, charcoal, stone, teal, mustard, mahogany, walnut, cherry, oak, birch, white or black.

power_draw_w.label: Power draw (W)
power_draw_w.note: Watts drawn while it runs; 0 for anything that uses no electricity.

dining_kind.label: Piece
dining_kind.note: Which piece: dining_table, round_table, china_cabinet, bar_cart, wine_rack, dining_chair, host_chair or dining_bench.
